about: Decay measurements of the user's Keyscape render of the note sweep (tools/fitting/make_note_sweep.py; fit_decay.py measure-sweep). Per velocity and measured partial: the mean level in each window after the strike, dB re the first window, null under the noise floor + 10.0 dB or after 10.0 s (the notes are held 11.0 s). Derived numbers only: no audio.
